audit_method: For every source proposal, identify each post-change behavior and ask whether omitting it leaves the reported defect or required boundary unresolved. Preservation clauses remain constraints; every other necessary behavior must be an explicit author request.

required_actions: Use a stable source-run timestamp or deterministic token
Add a task-level error boundary
Emit llm_scoring only when the real template is available
constraints: Keep the sound aggregate conversion intact

required_actions: Add a nearest-data-ancestor note with the repeated-data example
Stop identity comparison when check_path_structure owns a path error
Add a short guidance section
constraints: The section can state the alias trigger, warning-only result, and single-record evidence limit

required_actions: Resolve network-mode refs once to a commit SHA
constraints: Keep offline replay on the stored immutable ref without network access

required_actions: Use the shared parser in the module entry point
Add one offline entry-point test covering defaults
Validate numeric fields as finite values under metric rules
Enter invalid rows in SourceConversionResult
Store pinned prompt content in new snapshots
Mark missing prompt content in legacy snapshots
constraints: Legacy snapshots can leave prompt_template unset
items.missing_explicit_action: Mark missing prompt content in legacy snapshots

required_actions: Query present-null entries in live mode
Resolve exact canonical IDs first
Resolve normalized spellings only when one organization owns them
Stage complete output before publication
Reject existing logical output until replacement is atomic
items.missing_explicit_action: Reject existing logical output until replacement is atomic

required_actions: Use data/<collection> for smoke output
Pass a quoted fixed-depth file glob to validation
Enter invalid scores in the failure report
Omit incomplete token usage
constraints: Base token means only on complete values

required_actions: Use evaluation_name to distinguish tasks
constraints: Keep accuracy as the metric ID

required_actions: Require at least one path for --parquet
Integrate current main before moving the adapter and references
Derive the expected value from the imported schema version
Use task-specific evaluation names to preserve benchmark identity
constraints: Keep accuracy as the metric ID

required_actions: Reject existing output JSON before UUID generation or batch publication
Use the batch publisher for new or empty targets
Fail by default for symlinks, roots, and populated targets until replacement has an ownership manifest
items.missing_explicit_action: Fail by default for symlinks, roots, and populated targets

required_actions: Use metric cells as the source unit
Count each attempted or rejected cell once
Retain row references for malformed objects and missing datasets
Restrict tolerance to scale classification
Add a strict pre-publication check for unproven overruns
Set a unit only when the canonical contract or an explicit conversion proves it

decision: The preselected Luna output fails the holdout action-lock gate. Sol cannot replace it post hoc because the finalist protocol froze Luna before opening the holdout.
